name: Summit AZ - Blog - July 2026 Batch Brief
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-06-25

# Summary
Shared brief for the six-post July 2026 blog batch on the Arizona site. Opens with a hard rule: AZ site only, do not mention Utah, do not reference Pipeliners or Alphalete.

# Rules in the brief
- Voice: helpful local plumber, plain and warm, short sentences, no em dashes.
- Never name or link a competitor. Only link to URLs on the approved list; external links only to neutral .gov/.edu authorities, 1 to 2 max.
- No invented numbers (prices, PSI, gallons, lifespans, percentages) unless cited to a linked authority.
- Structure: one H1 with the keyphrase, a Quick answer paragraph first, question-style H2s, a 4 to 5 question FAQ, CTA close, body 1,000 to 1,500 words, Arizona localization (hard water, heat, monsoon, slab-on-grade, desert soil).
- Output format: META BLOCK, article, Verification block. Reference file: `blogs/signs-of-a-slab-leak.md`.
- Service area: Chandler (primary), Gilbert, Mesa, Tempe, Phoenix, Scottsdale, Queen Creek, San Tan Valley, Apache Junction, Fountain Hills.

# Already published (do not duplicate)
Signs of hard water, hidden water leak, outdoor faucet leaking, new water heater, prevent clogged drains, water softeners worth it, tankless vs tank, slab leak, trenchless pipe lining.
